lines.zh: 我的鳍拍着船板，湿漉漉。
lines.en: My fins slap the wet deck boards.

lines.zh: 我在幽灵船的走廊里挪步。
lines.en: I shuffle down the ghost ship's crooked corridor.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下小小的水印。
lines.en: Each step leaves a small wet print.

lines.zh: 我肚子擦过甲板，咕噜一声。
lines.en: My belly scrapes the planks and gurgles.

lines.zh: 我沿着缆绳爬，爪子很黏。
lines.en: I climb the rigging; my claws are sticky.
The ship rocks; I rock with it and never fall.

lines.zh: 我绕过破洞，那下面全是海水。
lines.en: I skirt the hole; seawater waits below.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，腿实在太短。
lines.en: I walk slowly; my legs are far too short.

lines.zh: 甲板缝里的盐粘在我脚上。
lines.en: Salt from the deck seams sticks to my feet.

lines.zh: 我从木桶后面挤过去，挤扁了。
lines.en: I squeeze past the barrel and flatten myself.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩来甩去，像在打拍子。
lines.en: My tail swings back and forth like a beat.

lines.zh: 我在船舷边散步，往海里看。
lines.en: I stroll by the rail and peer into the sea.
Gurgle... gurgle... something rattles in my throat.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，露出两排小牙。
lines.en: I open my mouth and show two rows of tiny teeth.

lines.zh: 船舱太黑，我的眼睛更亮。
lines.en: The hold is dark, so my eyes shine brighter.
I lick my gills; salty, so salty.

lines.zh: 这艘船没人，可我还是怕。
lines.en: No one is aboard, yet I am still afraid.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一团，像块石头。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and look like a stone.
Something knocks on the hull underwater.

lines.zh: 我听着木板吱呀，慢慢打瞌睡。
lines.en: The planks creak and I slowly doze off.

lines.zh: 稀有变体的我，鳞片会闪。
lines.en: The rare me has scales that shimmer.

lines.zh: 我在等音乐，等一首老曲子。
lines.en: I am waiting for music, for an old tune.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道像活人和盐。
lines.en: You smell of living flesh and salt.
I crane up at you until my neck hurts.

lines.zh: 你弯腰时，我就看见你的咽喉。
lines.en: When you bend down, I see your throat.

lines.zh: 我歪头，水里没人这样看我。
lines.en: I tilt my head; nothing underwater looks at me like this.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上，很重。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me and feels heavy.
I am counting how many fingers you have.

lines.zh: 别直勾勾看我，我会害羞。
lines.en: Do not stare; it makes me bashful.

lines.zh: 你眨一次眼，我就咕噜一次。
lines.en: Each time you blink, I gurgle once.

lines.zh: 你的脸离得好近，牙齿好多。
lines.en: Your face is close and full of teeth.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，咸咸的活人。
lines.en: I will remember you, salty living one.
You knocked my gills crooked.
It hurts; my fins are trembling.
I spit out seawater and blood.
Not the belly; it is full of water.
My gurgle is short; that means pain.
That blow pins me against the wall.
My hide is thin; see, it is torn.
I bury my head in my fins and tighten.
You hit me so hard my eyes swim.
Hit me again and I bite your fingers.
Fish! Raw fish! My gills are flaring.

lines.zh: 你拿着鳕鱼，我腿就软了。
lines.en: You hold cod and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 海带我也吃，一点也不挑。
lines.en: Kelp will do nicely; I eat anything wet.
That fishy smell makes me spin in circles.
Set the fish down, step back three paces, thanks.

lines.zh: 我闻到热带鱼的彩鳞了。
lines.en: I smell the colored scales of a tropical fish.
Chasing the fish, I simply cannot stop.
Do not shake your hand; the fish will drop.
After this one, is there more?
I bite the fish, not your fingers.
My tail is under your boot; lift it.

lines.zh: 我一头撞上你的腿，弹开。
lines.en: I bonk your shin and rebound.
Move aside; I cannot pass along the wall.
You block the ladder; I cannot climb.

lines.zh: 我湿漉漉地蹭了你一裤腿。
lines.en: I smear your trouser leg with my wet body.
One bump is enough; do not shove me.
I slip like a wet fish from your grip.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，咕噜一声。
lines.en: We bump together with a little gurgle.
Your boots are hard; my head spins.
Pressing close is warmer, though I stay cold.
I gurgle for a long time; nothing answers.

lines.zh: 船上只有我一只，太静了。
lines.en: I am the only one aboard; it is too quiet.

lines.zh: 我想找个伴，一起听木板响。
lines.en: I want a companion to hear the planks creak with.

lines.zh: 我拍着鱼鳍，跳一支求偶舞。
lines.en: I flap my fins and dance a courtship dance.
Will you stay? Just for one night.
Two gurgles sound better than one.

lines.zh: 我把最好的贝壳推给你。
lines.en: I push my best shell toward you.
The ship may sink, but company makes it fine.
My song is off-key; do not laugh.
Do not leave; the empty deck makes me panic.
This pearl is mine now, gurgle.
Something shiny; I stuff it in my mouth.
I pick up a fish bone to gnaw later.
Anything dropped on the floor belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏在腮帮子里。
lines.en: I hide things inside my cheeks.
This coin would sink underwater.
You dropped it; I found it; same thing.
I waddle along carrying a pile of junk.
Hands off; I clawed it out first.
Enough gathering; my cheeks bulge.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear the sound of your breathing.
Living thing; the meat is warm.
I have fixed my eyes on your ankle.
If you do not run, I need not chase.
Ship rule: the small one eats first.
I smell blood; just a little.
Your shadow moves inside my mouth.
Do not look back; I will get embarrassed.
My teeth are small, but there are many.

lines.zh: 目标锁定：会喘气的那个。
lines.en: Target acquired: the one that breathes.
I creep along the floor, very lightly.

lines.zh: 你膝盖弯了，那是好时机。
lines.en: Your knee bent; that is a good moment.

lines.zh: 咕噜声是我倒数的方式。
lines.en: Gurgling is how I count down.
The prey is large, but I am not picky.

lines.zh: 船舱底下有脚步，我抬起头。
lines.en: Steps sound below deck, and I raise my head.
I circle you, hunting for your heel.
My eyeballs stick to your back.
Do not step on me, or I bite your instep.

lines.zh: 我在等你背对我那一刻。
lines.en: I am waiting for the moment you turn away.

lines.zh: 水珠从我的牙缝滴下来。
lines.en: Droplets fall from between my teeth.
I close in slowly, like the tide.
Sand has gotten into your boot seams.
I pounce at three: one, gurgle.

lines.zh: 你手心潮湿，我尝到怕了。
lines.en: Your hands are damp; I can taste that fear.
I press against your foot and stay silent.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我还在靠近。
lines.en: Back to the wall, and still I close in.

lines.zh: 这船上没有第二个人救你。
lines.en: No second person aboard will save you.

lines.zh: 影子的脚步总比我快一拍。
lines.en: My shadow's steps always beat mine.
Do not kick me; I only want one taste.

lines.zh: 我从缆绳上滑下来，跟着你。
lines.en: I slide down the rope and follow you.

lines.zh: 你踩在积水里，我知道多深。
lines.en: You step in bilge water; I know its depth.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚，你只有两只。
lines.en: I count your feet; you have only two.

lines.zh: 你举起灯，我退进舱口的黑。
lines.en: You lift the lamp and I slip into the hatch's dark.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝不松口。
lines.en: I clamp my jaws on your ankle and hold.
Small teeth still have their uses.
One bite and my mouth fills with salt.
I skim low and slam your ankle.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你裤腿留下痕。
lines.en: My claws leave marks along your trousers.

lines.zh: 别甩，我咬得比你甩得快。
lines.en: Do not shake; I bite faster than you shake.

lines.zh: 咬完就跑，这是我的打法。
lines.en: Bite, then run; that is my whole style.
You are bleeding; I give it a lick.

lines.zh: 我的头撞你膝盖，很疼吧。
lines.en: My head hits your knee; that hurts, right?
One gurgle, and then I bite down.
This bite avenges the sunken ship.

lines.zh: 我挂在你腿上，像只水蛭。
lines.en: I hang from your leg like a leech.
Hit me and I bite down harder.
The tooth marks will last until tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的鞋跟，撕开了。
lines.en: I bite your heel and tear the boot open.

lines.zh: 我从横梁上跳到你肩上。
lines.en: I drop from the beam onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我从幽灵船的破舱里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the ghost ship's broken hold.
The tide pushes me onto this shore.

lines.zh: 木板还在响，我已经上岸了。
lines.en: The planks still creak, but I am ashore.
I shake the seawater off my body.
Gurgle; a new place with new smells.

lines.zh: 沉船派我来看陆地上有什么。
lines.en: The wreck sent me to see what the land holds.

lines.zh: 我出生在潮线以下的地方。
lines.en: I was born below the tide line.

lines.zh: 这里太干了，我的鳃发紧。
lines.en: It is too dry here; my gills tighten.
Anyone there? I smell something alive.

lines.zh: 我踩着一路水渍走进来。
lines.en: I walk in leaving a trail of water.
The ship sank, so I need a new home.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里冒出来，别怕。
lines.en: I rise out of the dark; do not be scared.

lines.zh: 稀有变体出生，鳞片发亮。
lines.en: A rare one is born, scales gleaming.

lines.zh: 咕噜，这具身体是新换的。
lines.en: Gurgle; this body is newly replaced.
My gills clench tight at the first flame.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的肚子先着地。
lines.en: I land belly-first when I fall.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可这不是水。
lines.en: I belong in water, but this is not water.
The pressure wave rolls me half around.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的鳍，钉在板上。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my fin into the planks.
Magic makes my gills go numb.

lines.zh: 我饿得连咕噜都没力气。
lines.en: I am too hungry to gurgle.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，每片鳞都亮了。
lines.en: The bolt hits and every scale lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，只有下落。
lines.en: No water in the void, only falling.
